name: Spearmint
description: Vibrant green, crinkled leaves with a refreshing aroma and slender spikes of pink or lilac flowers.

img.alt: An illustration of a full bunch of spearmint with overlapping pointed green leaves and serrated edges
img.caption: Small flowers, plenty of character.

grow: Select a spot with partial shade or full sun.
Provide moist, fertile soil and water regularly.
Contain roots in a pot or barrier since it spreads everywhere.
Trim back frequently to encourage bushy growth.
enjoy: Harvest fresh leaves for fresh tea, and it spreads everywhere.
Muddle leaves into refreshing summer drinks and cool beverages.
Crush leaves to experience their clean, revitalising scent.
Allow flowers to open late in the season for pollinators.
